sentiment: Every return to the native ground is a confession: the past was never gone, only waiting to be needed again.

stories.title: Shopify is moving from React Native back to Swift and Kotlin
stories.summary: A company walks back years of abstraction to stand on the platform's own ground again — the engineering equivalent of returning home, and admitting the borrowed layer never fit quite right.

stories.title: Don't let anyone take away your big box of cables
stories.summary: A defense of the drawer of obsolete connectors, kept against the day they are needed — the small, stubborn faith that the past is stored, not discarded.

stories.title: Technique for Manipulating Satellite Photos Now Reveals Ancient Images (2025)
stories.summary: Imaging meant for orbit, turned on the buried past, surfaces what was always there beneath the ground — proof that the right light can make ancient things new again.
